item.title: Gunsmoke - Gold Mine
item.description: Kitty meets a young mute boy in a rough mining town where she's come to claim a gold mine.

item.title: The Big Valley - A Flock of Trouble
item.description: Nick is tricked into winning a flock of sheep in a card game. His first instinct is to get rid of them immediately, but his neighbors’ reactions start to rankle and he finds himself increasingly unable to back down as a matter of principle.

item.title: Wagon Train - The Luke O'Malley Story
item.description: Luke O'Malley, fleeing Mexican bandits whom he double crossed, joins the wagon train disguised as a minister.

item.title: The Wild Wild West - The Night of the Deadly Bed
item.description: Facing execution at the hands of a madman, West learns the crazed assassin plans to reclaim Mexico---as the new Napoleon.

item.title: The Woody Woodpecker Show - Peck of Trouble, Scrambled Eggs, The Dog That Cried Wolf, Woodpecker Wanted, Pigeon Holed, Charlie's Campout, Ballyhooey
item.description: "Woody drives two park rangers in a national forest insane by pecking holes in all the trees., A mischievous satyr switches the eggs of several different nests to confuse the expectant forest animals., Dizzy the sheep dog pranks his owner that a wolf is attacking the sheep. item.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Little Quacker, Counterfeit Cat, Switchin' Kitten
item.description: "Jerry saves a baby duck from Tom as the cat prepares to eat it., A cat, disguised as the neighbor dog, uses many bones to get past Spike and after a bird in a cage., Tom and Jerry enter an old castle on a dark and stormy night which is owned by a mad scientist."

item.title: Popeye and Pals - Plumbing Is a “Pipe”, Baby Be Good, Goonland
item.description: "Popeye visits Olive Oyl and discovers her home in turmoil because of a broken water pipe., Betty Boop tells naughty Little Jimmy a corrective fairy tale., Popeye sails in search of his father, Poopdeck, who has been missing for forty years."

item.title: The Beverly Hillbillies - The Continental Touch
item.description: Having been given a stylish makeover by a famous French couturier, Elly May is mistaken for a visiting foreign princess by Mrs. Drysdale. Hoping to get in good with "royalty," Mrs. Drysdale throws a fancy party for Elly. This time around, the old dear is certain that her soiree won't be invaded by "those dreadful hillbillies."

item.title: The Beverly Hillbillies - The House of Granny
item.description: Granny is waking up the family so they can get to their new store: The House of Granny. Jethro wakes up sleepy, not wanting to be up, but as soon as Granny mentions breakfast, he is dressed in a split second. Jed is carving a Y in the kitchen, and when Jethro sees the shavings in the bowl, he thinks it is cereal. Jed tells him to have corn flakes instead. Granny goes to wake up Elly May, saying that her store opens at a decent hour—the crack of dawn!
